name: Wheat–Corn Spread: ZW vs ZC Relative Value
description: Research study analyzing the wheat/corn price spread (ZW minus ZC) relative to its historical range. Panel 1 shows the spread level with dual-color area fill (green when above 3-year rolling mean, red when below), a 20-day SMA overlay, seasonal average spread by calendar month, and a summary table with current spread, 3-year stats, percentile rank, and YoY changes for both legs. Panel 2 shows ZW and ZC prices indexed to 100 at the start, plus ZW and ZC YoY percentage changes over time to identify which leg is driving the spread.
source:
# =============================================================================
# WHEAT–CORN SPREAD: ZW vs ZC RELATIVE VALUE
# =============================================================================
# Question: Where does the wheat/corn price spread stand relative to its
#   historical range, and which leg is driving the current level?
#
# Panel 1 — Spread Level vs History:
#   - xy_lines (area): ZW–ZC spread with dual-color fill (green above 3yr
#     mean, red below) and 20-day SMA overlay
#   - xy_bars: Average ZW–ZC spread by calendar month (seasonal profile)
#   - summary_table: Current spread, 3yr avg/high/low, percentile rank,
#     current ZW/ZC prices, YoY % changes
#
# Panel 2 — Which Leg Is Weaker:
#   - xy_lines: ZW and ZC indexed to 100 at start
#   - xy_lines: ZW YoY% and ZC YoY% over time
#
# Dataset:
#   - ZW-Futures (primary), ZC via reference_futures
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZW (primary asset) ---
src = market_data_source()()
zw_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
zw_close = zw_cont.c

# --- Data: ZC (reference) ---
zc_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZC")()
zc_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zc_ref.o, zc_ref.h, zc_ref.l, zc_ref.c, zc_ref.v, zc_ref.oi, zc_ref.s)
zc_close = zc_cont.c

# --- Spread: ZW minus ZC (cents/bushel) ---
spread = zw_close - zc_close

# --- Spread analytics ---
spread_sma20 = ma(period=20)(spread)
spread_3y_avg = ma(period=756)(spread)     # ~3 years of trading days
spread_3y_high = max(period=756)(spread)
spread_3y_low = min(period=756)(spread)
spread_pctrank = percentrank(period=756)(spread)

# Dual-color area: green when above 3yr mean, red when below
spread_diff = spread - spread_3y_avg
spread_abs = abs(spread_diff)
spread_above = (spread_diff + spread_abs) / 2   # positive part (wheat premium above normal)
spread_below = (spread_diff - spread_abs) / 2   # negative part (wheat unusually weak)

# --- YoY returns for each leg (~252 trading days) ---
zw_yoy = returns(period=252)(zw_close)
zc_yoy = returns(period=252)(zc_close)

# --- Index both to 100 at start ---
zw_ret = returns(period=1)(zw_close)
zc_ret = returns(period=1)(zc_close)
zw_indexed = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1 + zw_ret) * 100
zc_indexed = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1 + zc_ret) * 100

# --- Seasonal: month number for grouping ---
bar_ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component='month')(bar_ts)

# =====================================================================
# PANEL 1 — Spread Level vs History
# =====================================================================

# Chart 1: Dual-color area spread vs 3yr rolling mean
xy_lines(
    title='Wheat–Corn Spread vs 3-Year Rolling Average',
    category='1. Spread Level vs History',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='Spread Deviation from 3Y Avg (¢/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="3Y Average")
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Above Average (Wheat Premium)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Below Average (Wheat Weak)', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spread 20-Day SMA', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, spread_above, spread_below, spread_sma20 - spread_3y_avg)

# Chart 2: Average spread by calendar month (seasonal profile)
xy_bars(
    title='Average Wheat–Corn Spread by Month (Seasonal Profile)',
    category='1. Spread Level vs History',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg Spread (¢/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    order=2
)(spread, month_num)

# Chart 3: Summary statistics table
# Row 0 (Spread): Current | 3Y Avg | 3Y High
# Row 1 (Spread): Pctile Rank | 3Y Low | (empty)
# Row 2 (Legs):   ZW Price | ZC Price | (empty)
# Row 3 (YoY):    ZW YoY % | ZC YoY % | (empty)
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Wheat–Corn Spread Summary',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Spread (¢/bu)', 'Spread Range', 'Current Prices', 'Year-over-Year'],
        col_headers=['Value 1', 'Value 2', 'Value 3'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, info='Current Spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, info='3-Year Average'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, info='Percentile Rank (0-100)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, info='3-Year High'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, info='3-Year Low'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, info='Wheat (ZW) Price'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, info='Corn (ZC) Price'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='ZW YoY Change'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='ZC YoY Change')
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Spread Level vs History',
    order=3
)(spread, spread_3y_avg, spread_pctrank, spread_3y_high, spread_3y_low, zw_close, zc_close, zw_yoy, zc_yoy)

# =====================================================================
# PANEL 2 — Which Leg Is Weaker
# =====================================================================

# Chart 4: ZW and ZC indexed to 100 at start
xy_lines(
    title='Wheat vs Corn: Indexed Price Performance (Base = 100)',
    category='2. Which Leg Is Weaker',
    y_axis_label='Indexed Price (100 = Start)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=100, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Base (100)")
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Wheat (ZW)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Corn (ZC)', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, zw_indexed, zc_indexed)

# Chart 5: ZW and ZC YoY % changes
xy_lines(
    title='Year-over-Year Price Change: Wheat vs Corn',
    category='2. Which Leg Is Weaker',
    y_axis_label='YoY Change',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="0%")
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Wheat YoY %', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Corn YoY %', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, zw_yoy, zc_yoy)
